quotes.author: DDavid LockwoodGoogle Review
quotes.text: I can't say enough positive things about our experience with Noam. We hired him to captain a boat owned by someone in our party, but we unexpectedly ran into mechanical issues. Noam went above and beyond: reaching out to his contacts, helping us troubleshoot, and refusing to leave our side until a solution was found. He arranged a last-minute charter for us on the Saturday of Labor Day weekend, no small feat, and stayed with us until it arrived. Thanks to him, we ended up having a fantastic afternoon on Lake Austin.

quotes.author: MMatthew GorrickGoogle Review
quotes.text: We had an absolutely fantastic experience renting a pontoon boat on Lake Austin with this company. We had a group of 10 family members, and from start to finish, everything was smooth, easy, and well organized. The pontoon boat itself was clean, comfortable, and in great condition, with plenty of space for our entire group. The staff was friendly, professional, and helpful throughout the entire process. We made some great memories and will definitely be booking with them again in the future!

quotes.author: BBrenda BogueGoogle Review
quotes.text: Our chartered cruise with LakeTime Austin Boat Rentals made for the perfect Father's Day! Noam was a captain extraordinaire and provided a wonderful tour of Lake Austin, pointing out celebrity homes and other points of interest. He found the best spot on the lake for swimming and family water fun. The pontoon boat was beautiful and comfy. This was our second cruise with LakeTime and it won't be the last.

quotes.author: SSathvik VarmaGoogle Review
quotes.text: Had an amazing boat ride experience! I really enjoyed exploring the lake. The captain was very friendly, helpful, and guided us so well throughout the ride. He also took some great pictures for us and explained everything clearly about the surroundings. Overall, it was a wonderful experience and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a fun and relaxing boat tour!

quotes.author: VVictoria EmmaGoogle Review
quotes.text: We had the most amazing experience today! The captain was very friendly, accommodating, and easygoing. Totally relaxed, beautiful experience on board and in the water. Definitely recommend it, we're making this our new tradition.

quotes.author: PPratyusha PusapatiGoogle Review
quotes.text: Noam gave us a great ride, he was smooth during the ride and friendly all along. He was patient enough while we were enjoying the swims and taking photos during the trip around the lake. Would love to come back again.
